title: Reopen Work Order sits in the invoice menu where Reverse would be
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced, billable, so Reverse can be compared.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
  4. Open work order 2.
  5. Open the Finance tab.
  6. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The header shows the "Closed on …" line and no Reopen button.

Step 2:

  • The document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers "Reopen Work Order" and no "Issue Credit".

Step 4:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 5:

  • The document shows.

Step 6:

  • The menu offers "Reverse".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-R1: “On a closed internal or no-charge work order the Finance tab's invoice menu shows "Reopen Work Order" where a billable work order shows "Reverse", and no Issue Credit. It is the only place to reopen; the work order header carries the line of S2-R9 and no button.”
  • S4-N2: “If the work order is billable and invoiced, the existing Reverse behaviour applies, unchanged.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "05 Finance tab · closed" (page "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order"), "29 Closed · NO CHARGE document" (page "Happy flow v6"), "01 Work order · Closed" (page "Flow 3 · Reopen"), "36 Closed work order" (page "Happy flow v6").
